text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Half-hours of net export per MW (Bicker Fen: per 5 MW), all history, from cleaned unflagged power. Rows are seasons. Bicker Fen's thermal limit is a Technical Limit and its sign is unconfirmed. The published thermal limit is a ceiling NGED does not operate to. Limits are NGED's, Supported by NGED Open Data.'
text.tspan: Half-hours of net export per MW (Bicker Fen: per 5 MW), all history, from cleaned unflagged power.
Rows are seasons. Bicker Fen's thermal limit is a Technical Limit and its sign is unconfirmed. The
published thermal limit is a ceiling NGED does not operate to. Limits are NGED's, Supported by NGED
